comparison.objective: Paint a wall edge using an edger without marking trim; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires maintaining pad angle, wall pressure and wheel guidance during a long stroke. Candidate requires small-tool insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores painted-grid coverage, clean trim and tool return. Candidate scores repeated carriage stopping and retained adjustment, with rebound, overload and drift limits still missing.
comparison.reason: Surface finishing under guided contact is unrelated to mechanical adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
